goal: Convert the product weights in products.txt to grams and save them as weights.csv.
criteria: weights.csv has the header product,weight_g and one row per product in the original order. weight_g is an integer number of grams, rounded to the nearest gram (1 lb = 453.59237 g, 1 oz = 28.349523125 g). Each value must be within 1 g of the correct one.
evidence_hint: Conversion factors and rounding you used.
